title: OpenClaw CRM Automation: Sync Your Agent With HubSpot and Salesforce
summary: OpenClaw CRM automation setup guide: sync your AI agent with HubSpot or Salesforce to auto-update deals, log interactions, and track leads — hands-free.
body_markdown: Add explicit field mapping to your automation rules: "Map company headcount to HubSpot's 'numberofemployees' field" or "Write the prospect's tech stack to the custom field 'tech_stack_notes'." The agent reads these as natural-language policies and applies them when writing to the CRM. You don't configure field mappings through a GUI — you describe the mapping in plain English and the agent handles the API field names behind the scenes.
